nodes.name: Hydrothermal MoO3 nanorods synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.8 g of (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O was added in the mixed solutions of HNO3 and H2O with a volume ratio of 1:3. The resultant solution was transferred into an autoclave and then treated under 180 °C for 18 h. Then the gray precipitate was washed thrice with ethanol and water and then dried at 60 °C for overnight.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal MoOx@Ni(OH)2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.2 g of Ni(NO3)2·6H2O and 0.026 g of NH4F were dissolved into 20 mL of water and stirred for 20 min; 30 mg of the as-synthesized MoO3 nanorods was dispersed into the above mixed solution and 0.35 mL of NH3OH was added dropwise under constant stirring. Then the resultant solution was subjected to hydrothermal treatment under 100 °C for 12 h. The acquired precipitates were washed thrice with ethanol and water and then dried at 60 °C overnight.

nodes.name: CVD sulfurization to MoOx@NiS2
nodes.procedure: 200 mg of sulfur powder was placed in the furnace at the farthest upstream place and 30 mg of MoOx@Ni(OH)2 was placed at the downstream position of the furnace. Then, the furnace was heated at 300 °C under N2 atmosphere for 1 h with a ramp rate of 10 °C/min.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pristine MoO3 shows characteristic peaks at 12.7°, 22.5°, 25.7°, 27.4°, 39.1° (020, 110, 040, 021, 060). Pristine NiS2 shows cubic phase peaks at 27.3°, 31.6°, 35.4°, 38.9°, 45.2°, 53.5°, 61.1° (111, 200, 210, 211, 311, 321). MoOx@NiS2 shows overlapping peaks, weak MoO2 (021) at 37.1°, and peak shifts to lower angles indicating heterointerfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD patterns of pristine MoO3 match well with the corresponding diffraction peaks (020), (110), (040), (021) and (060) being observed at 12.7°, 22.5°, 25.7°, 27.4° and 39.1° (Fig. 1a).

nodes.characterization_summary: Pristine MoO3: monodispersed nanorods, length 2-3 μm, width 270 nm. MoOx@Ni(OH)2: nanorods with rough nanowrinkled surface, length 2-3 μm, width 800 nm. MoOx@NiS2: preserves morphology, width slightly decreased. Pristine NiS2: spherical flower-like, diameter 2.2 μm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM image displays monodispersed MoO3 nanorods with the length and width of 2-3 μm and 270 nm, respectively (Fig. 1b).

nodes.characterization_summary: MoOx@NiS2 shows rod-like morphology with porous feature, length 2.9 μm and width 745 nm. HRTEM shows interplanar distance of 0.28 nm corresponding to (200) planes of NiS2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM observation further visualizes the rod-like morphology of MoOx@NiS2 hybrid but with porous feature; the length and width are about 2.9 μm and 745 nm, respectively (Fig. 2a).

nodes.characterization_summary: MoOx@NiS2 Brunauer-Emmett-Teller surface area 91.9 m²/g (vs NiS2 52.1 m²/g). BJH average pore size MoOx@NiS2 3.82 nm (vs NiS2 3.81 nm), type-IV isotherms confirm mesoporous structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) surface area of MoO_x@NiS_2 is determined to be 91.9 m² g⁻¹, much higher than that of NiS_2 (52.1 m² g⁻¹).

nodes.characterization_summary: MoOx@NiS2: Mo 3d Mo⁴⁺ (232.65/229.1 eV), Mo⁶⁺ (235.6/232.2 eV); Ni 2p shows Ni³⁺/Ni²⁺ peaks upshifted vs pristine NiS2; S 2p shows S²⁻ (163.9/162.3 eV), S₂²⁻ (163.4/161.9 eV), sulfate (168.9 eV) with shifts indicating charge transfer at heterointerfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XPS survey spectra reveal that MoO_x@NiS_2 consists of Ni, Mo, S and O elements.

nodes.characterization_summary: Interplanar distance of 0.28 nm between lattice fringes belongs to (200) lattice planes of NiS2 in MoOx@NiS2 hybrid.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the HR-TEM image (Fig. 2b), the interplanar distance between the two lattice fringes is 0.28 nm which belongs to the (200) lattice planes of NiS2.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX mapping shows Mo and O mainly in inner section of nanorods, Ni and S evenly dispersed at shell layer of MoOx@NiS2 hybrid.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDX mapping analyses corroborate the distribution of Ni, Mo, O and S elements in the MoO_x@NiS_2 hybrid (Fig. 2d-f), in which Mo and O element mainly locate in the inner section of the nanorods.

nodes.characterization_summary: MoOx@NiS2 shows Ni-S at 345 cm⁻¹, Mo=O bending at 284/375 cm⁻¹, Mo-O-Mo stretching at 818/887 cm⁻¹, and terminal Mo⁶⁺=O at 938 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman shift at 345 cm⁻¹ corresponds to the characteristic vibration modes of Ni-S bond. The peaks at 284 and 375 cm⁻¹ correspond to the bending mode of Mo=O vibration and the scissoring mode of O-Mo-O, respectively.
